business_problem: Ryt Bank needed to replace rigid, multi-screen banking journeys with a conversational payment experience while still meeting the low-latency, auditability, and security requirements of a regulated financial institution.
solution_summary: Ryt Bank built a conversational payment-transfer experience around its own Ryt AI engine and Tencent Cloud's messaging services so customers can move money with natural-language or image-based requests instead of stepwise banking screens. Natural-language and image inputs enter a chat interface backed by Tencent Cloud Chat(IM), which provides the core message-delivery channel for high-stakes banking interactions. Flexible APIs let Ryt Bank's multi-layer AI agents listen to incoming requests, verify intent, and trigger real-time payment execution, while Tencent RTC supplies the stable communication layer used during secure transaction processing. The architecture is designed for regulated banking workloads, so the same message pipeline must stay auditable, low-latency, and resilient enough to support more than 140,000 monthly transactional interactions without disrupting customer trust.

solution_components.name: Ryt AI
solution_components.role: Interprets customer payment instructions, verifies intent, and drives the conversational transfer workflow.

solution_components.name: Tencent Cloud Chat(IM)
solution_components.role: Carries the message stream that connects customers to the conversational banking experience.

solution_components.name: Tencent RTC
solution_components.role: Provides the stable real-time communication channel used during secure transaction processing.

data_flow: Customers submit text or image-based transfer requests through Ryt Bank's chat interface; Tencent Cloud Chat(IM) transports those messages to Ryt AI, which listens, verifies, and executes the payment flow, while Tencent RTC underpins the secure real-time communication channel used to complete and record the transaction.
business_outcome: Ryt Bank launched an AI-powered transfer experience that reduced a traditional eight-step payment process to a single sentence while preserving the low latency, transparency, and operational safety expected of a regulated bank.
metrics: The infrastructure must handle more than 140,000 monthly transactional interactions without service disruption.
